items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'Yeah' to the interviewer's statement about John Skank; no personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. He told me... He said he couldn't understand why people acted like that. That all he had to do was just tell him not to use the phone, and he wouldn't use the phone. But here he was sitting in his easy chair, and the phone was right at his elbow, and this was his spot in the apartment, and there was a constant reminder that he kind of wasn't welcome, I guess, or that there was a limited welcome. Yeah. Yeah. So, but he invited me, you know, up to spend the afternoons with him. I guess this was a period…
If I remember rightly, I know I moved away from Pittsburgh in the spring of 1947, and I timed my leaving there to stop in Chicago when he went up for a concert or two for Skank.
